answer: A violet lantern marks each agent's entry checkpoint: to join, an agent must complete verifiable useful work attested by five independent peers, and its reputation then decays daily unless it keeps contributing, so an oasis of rewards can only be sustained by continuous real effort. Creating a hundred fake identities multiplies the work a hundredfold while per-identity rewards stay capped, making a Sybil farm cost more in compute and attestation fees than it can ever earn back.
